title: Rectangular plate
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. This ensures that the origin is at the default position. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. The first loop consists of four lines: the first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0), the second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.1549), the third line starts at (0.75, 0.1549) and ends at (0.0, 0.1549), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by starting at (0.0, 0.1549) and ending at the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a translation vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0082 units to create a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The final dimensions of the rectangular plate are 0.7499999999999998 units in length, 0.15489130434782603 units in width, and 0.008152173913043478 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1549) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1549) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular plate
r = r.extrude(0.0082)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
